install_output_empty: Akukho okukhiphayo okwamanje. Imigqa yetheminali evela ethuluzini lokufaka izovela lapha.
linux_setup_title: I-Linux Flashing & Ukusethwa kwethuluzi le-SP Flash
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Ilanda futhi ilungise injini ekhanyayo enesivinini esikhulu ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisela futhi ubuyekeze isidlali sakho kalula.
linux_card_engine_desc: Ithuluzi lomdabu le-MediaTek elikhanyayo elihambisana nomtapo wolwazi wendawo yonke kusiteji.
linux_card_usb_desc: Inikeza imvume yedeskithophu ukuze uxhumane nomdlali ngemodi ye-Bootloader.
system_checker_title: Isihloli Sesistimu ye-SP Flash Tool & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Ukuqinisekiswa okuphelele kwabashayeli, amamojula e-kernel, izimvume, namalabhulali wesikhathi sokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhanya okuthembekile.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Ilungiselela ikhompuyutha yakho ukuxhuma kusidlali sakho ukuze uthole izibuyekezo zesofthiwe.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ihlola ukusethwa kwe-Linux okuthuthukisiwe kwe-SP Flash Tool, ukufinyelela kwe-USB, izimvume ze-serial, nezingxenye zesistimu.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Ilungiselela ikhompuyutha yakho ukuthi ixhume kusidlali sakho futhi ifake izibuyekezo zesofthiwe ngokuthembekile.
settings_checker_desc: Ilungiselela ikhompuyutha yakho ukuthi ixhume kusidlali sakho futhi ifake izibuyekezo zesofthiwe ngokuthembekile.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Ikhompyutha yakho isilungele ukuxhuma kusidlali sakho.
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Ungakwazi ukuxhuma umdlali wakho uma ebuzwa.
linux_prep_blocked: Le khompyutha ayikwazi ukusebenzisa i-SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Iphasiwedi yakho iyadingeka kanye ukuze umise le khompyutha ukuthi ikhanyise: imithetho ye-USB yamadivayisi we-MediaTek kanye nokufinyelela kwembobo ye-serial.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Ukusethela le khompyutha i-SP Flash Tool, iphasiwedi yakho izodingeka esinyathelweni esilandelayo ukuze ulungise imithetho ye-USB futhi wengeze i-akhawunti yakho kumaqembu abasebenzisi be-serial adingekayo. Uma wenqaba, uhlelo lokusebenza luzovala.
linux_prep_fixed: Ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe, Ithuluzi le-SP Flash selilungile.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Ukusetha kuqedile futhi i-akhawunti yakho yengeziwe emaqenjini abasebenzisi adingekayo ku-SP Flash Tool. Sicela uqale kabusha ikhompuyutha yakho ukuze izimvume ezintsha zisebenze, bese uvule uhlelo lokusebenza futhi. Chofoza uphawu lokuhlola ukuze uvale uhlelo lokusebenza manje.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kwenziwe, Vala Uhlelo Lokusebenza ukuze Uqalise kabusha Ikhompyutha
settings_driver_desc: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza okokuqala ngqa, kufanele ufake umshayeli we-MediaTek USB, bese uqalisa kabusha ikhompyutha yakho.
home_desc: Thola i-firmware ku-inthanethi noma khetha iphakheji yendawo, bese uyikhanyise kudivayisi yakho.
sel_source_desc: Landa i-firmware ku-inthanethi, noma ngenisa iphakheji yendawo.
settings_advanced_desc: Ibonisa indlela yokufaka, imodi yokufaka nezihlungi zokukhipha.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Uhlelo lokusebenza luhlala nawe ngokucisha, ukuxhuma, nokufaka.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ivala i-Updater CE bese ivula i-SP Flash Tool GUI ngefayela elikhethiwe le-firmware elihlakazayo nezithombe zokuhlukanisa ezilayishwe kuqala.
settings_terminal_desc: Isebenzisa ukufakwa kwesofthiwe yakho ku-Terminal ukuze ubone ulwazi lobuchwepheshe ngenqubekelaphambili.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Isebenzisa ukufakwa kwesofthiwe yakho ku-Command Prompt ukuze ubone ulwazi lobuchwepheshe ngenqubekelaphambili.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Ongakukhetha. Okunye okuhlosiwe kwe-MediaTek kwenqaba ukukhanya kuze kube yilapho i-SP Flash Tool inikezwa ifayela lokuqinisekisa (.auth); engeza eyakho lapha uma idivayisi iyidinga.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Alikho ifayela le-scatter elitholakele kule phakheji, ngakho-ke awukho umyalo wekhonsoli ongakhiwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Ayikho i-SP Flash Tool yokwakha noma indawo yokungena ye-MTKClient etholakalayo ngale ndlela.
terminal_install_failed: Ayikwazanga ukuvula iwindi letheminali. Umyalo wokufaka wawubhalwe ukuthi {path}.
status_terminal_install: Ukufaka umyalo ovuliwe efasiteleni lakho letheminali ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} manje izovula ukusebenza {method}.

• Uma ingakavaliwe, cisha {device} yakho.
• Uma ixhumeke ku-USB, yinqamule kuqala.
{hint}
• Xhuma idivayisi yakho kukhompuyutha yakho lapho {terminal_name} iwindi selivuliwe.

Chofoza okuthi KULUNGILE ukuze uqalise futhi uphume ku-Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ithiphu: Uma idivayisi ingaxhumeki ngokuzenzakalelayo, cindezela ngobumnene inkinobho yokusetha kabusha embotsheni yephinikhodi nge-paperclip ngenkathi uxhuma ikhebula le-USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Ithiphu: Faka idivayisi yakho kumodi yokulanda i-firmware (iyahluka ngemodeli: isb. khipha ibhethri futhi uyigcine ingaphandle ngentambo ye-USB exhunyiwe, noma vala ibhethri ngaphakathi, noma ubambe Ivolumu Phansi/Phezulu ngenkathi uxhuma i-USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
I-SP Flash Tool GUI manje izovula nge-firmware yakho elayishwe kuqala.

• Kuthuluzi le-SP Flash, khetha okuthi "Landa" ebhokisini lokudonsela phansi.
• Chofoza inkinobho ethi "Landa".
• Qiniseka ukuthi i-{device} yakho ivaliwe futhi inqanyuliwe.
{hint}
• Xhuma ikhebula le-USB kukhompyutha yakho ngemva kokuchofoza Landa.

Chofoza okuthi KULUNGILE ukuze uvule Ithuluzi le-SP Flash bese uphuma ku-Update CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Uma inikwe amandla, amatimu e-Rockbox adluliselwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-Y1 ngemva kokufakwa okuyimpumelelo kwe-Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Asikwazanga ukubeka iphekhi yamatimu kumdlali wakho. Ungazama futhi kokuthi Izilungiselelo.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Bonisa Isofthiwe Yoqobo ekhishwe ezindala kuno-3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Ukukhishwa Kwesoftware Yangempela okudala kuno-3.0.7 akuhambisani namayunithi e-Y1 athengiswa nge-Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ukukhanyisa isakhiwo esidala kulawa mayunithi kuzowavimbela ekuqaliseni kuze kube yilapho inguqulo entsha iphinde yafakwa.

Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukukhombisa ukukhishwa kweSofthiwe Yangempela okudala kuno-3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Ibonisa ukwakha okunezip ye-ROM ehlukile okungu-240p (rom…_240p.zip). Ukwakhiwa okungu-240p akuhambisani namayunithi e-Y1 ku-Innioasis OS ngaphansi kuka-3.0.7, ngakho-ke i-Show Old Rockbox Builds inikwe amandla nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ukukhishwa kwe-Rockbox-Y1 ngaphambi kuka-0.5 akuhambisani namayunithi e-Y1 athengiswe ngemva kuka-March 2026 nge-Innioasis OS 3.0.7 efakwe ngaphambili.

Ukukhanyisa isakhiwo esidala kulawa madivayisi kuzovimbela ukuqala.

Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukubonisa izakhiwo ezindala ze-Rockbox?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Sicela ukhethe i-.zip, .rar ingobo yomlando, noma ifayela le-scatter (*scatter*.txt) ngaphakathi kwefolda ye-firmware ukuze ufake i-firmware oyikhethile kokuthi {target} yakho.
sel_offline: Ukufakwa kuhlu ku-inthanethi akutholakali okwamanje. Sebenzisa ifayela lendawo, noma hlola ukuxhumana kwakho.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Kutholwe amaphakheji e-firmware amaningi noma amafayela okusabalalisa kule folda/ngobo yomlando. Sicela ukhethe ifolda noma ingobo yomlando equkethe iphakheji ye-firmware eyodwa ngesikhathi.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ngaphezu kwefayela elilodwa le-scatter, ngakho-ke i-Updater ayikwazi ukusho ukuthi yisiphi isakhiwo esidingwa umdlali wakho. Umthuthukisi we-{software} uzodinga ukubuyekeza ukukhishwa kwe-firmware yakhe ukuze afake kuphela ifayela elilodwa le-scatter.
sp_search_restart: Ayikho idivayisi okwamanje, iyasesha futhi (umzamo {count}). Gcina isidlali sivaliwe futhi usixhume lapho uyalwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Ifayela lokufakazela ubuqiniso alitholakali ({path}); ekhanyayo ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Ifayela le-scatter alisho inkundla yalo, ngakho-ke ukulungiselelwa kwekhonsoli yefayela lokuqinisekisa akukwazanga ukwakhiwa; ekhanyayo ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Ifayela le-scatter alisho uhlobo lwesitoreji (EMMC/NAND/UFS), ngakho ukulungiselelwa kwekhonsoli yefayela lokufakazela ubuqiniso akukwazanga ukwakhiwa; ekhanyayo ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Alikho ifayela lokufakazela ubuqiniso elinikeziwe; ekhanyayo ngaphandle koyedwa.
sp_config_write_failed: Ayikwazanga ukubhala ifayela lokumisa ikhonsoli; ekhanyayo ngaphandle kwefayela lokufakazela ubuqiniso.
settings_notifications_desc: Bonisa izaziso zesistimu zesaziso nezinhlobo zokubuyekeza ngezansi. Kuvaliwe kugcina yonke into ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Nika amandla izaziso uma uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe
settings_add_device_type_hint: Uhlobo inguqulo yehadiwe yomdlali. Abadlali bemodeli efanayo bangakhiwa ekubuyekezweni okungaphezu kokukodwa — isibonelo Uhlobo A nohlobo B — futhi isofthiwe yenzelwe oyedwa wabo. Bheka isitika ngemuva komdlali; uma ingasho uhlobo, shiya ukukhetha kokuqala.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Azikho izinguqulo ezitholakalayo zale softhiwe okwamanje.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Gcina uhlelo lokusebenza kubha yemenyu ngemva kokuvalwa kwewindi, ukuze usathola izaziso zesibuyekezo sohlelo lokusebenza nesidlali. Valiwe: ukuvala iwindi kumisa uhlelo lokusebenza.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Gcina uhlelo lokusebenza kuthreyi yesistimu ngemva kokuvalwa kwewindi, ukuze usathola izaziso zohlelo lokusebenza ne-firmware yesidlali. Valiwe: ukuvala iwindi kumisa uhlelo lokusebenza.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Fihla ikhathalogi yomphakathi eku-inthanethi futhi ufake isofthiwe evela kumafayela endawo kuphela.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ukhanyise isakhiwo se-Rockbox esingu-360p. Ungathanda ukufaka i-360p Theme Pack kule divayisi manje?
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Sicela unqamule i-USB, uvule futhi uvule ku-Rockbox kanye (ukuze iqalise ifolda yayo yangaphakathi yesistimu ye-.rockbox), bese uxhuma kabusha i-USB bese ukhetha 'Imodi Yesitoreji Se-USB'.

Uma uxhumekile, chofoza okuthi Qhubeka ukuze ukhethe noma iyiphi ifolda kusidlali sakho.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Khetha noma iyiphi ifolda kusitoreji sesidlali sakho esixhunyiwe
sel_themepack_success: I-Rockbox Theme Pack ifakwe ngempumelelo kudivayisi yakho!
sel_dialog_filter: Amafayela E-Firmware (*.zip *.rar *sakaza*.txt *.txt);;Izingobo Zomlando (*.zip *.rar); Amafayela Okusabalalisa (*sakaza*.txt *.txt);; Wonke Amafayela (*.*)
sel_only_local: Khetha iphakheji yendawo ye-.zip noma .rar, noma ifolda / ifayela le-.txt le-scatter, ukuze lifakwe ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi, ayidingi i-inthanethi. Isebenza nazo zonke isidlali somsindo se-Innioasis ne-Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Khetha iphakheji ye-firmware yasendaweni (.zip, .rar) noma ifolda equkethe ifayela le-scatter ukuze lifakwe ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi, elisebenza namadivayisi ajwayelekile e-MediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Faka i-firmware kusuka kufayela le-.zip noma le-.rar kunoma yisiphi isidlali somsindo se-Innioasis noma i-Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Faka i-firmware kusuka kungobo yomlando ye-.zip/.rar noma ifolda ye-firmware kumadivayisi ajwayelekile e-MediaTek.
conn_offline: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Ukufakwa okuvela kungobo yomlando ye-Firmware Yomphakathi akutholakali.
conn_archive_unavailable: Ikhathalogi ye-firmware ayitholakali okwamanje. Usengafaka usuka kungobo yomlando noma amafayela endawo.
single_instance_body: Enye ikhophi ivuliwe, noma isasebenza ngemuva. Amakhophi amabili azoqhudelana ngoxhumo lwe-USB lomdlali, ngakho leli ngeke liqale.
single_instance_focus_failed: Ikhophi esebenzayo ayizange iphendule isicelo sokubonisa iwindi layo. Kungase kube matasa noma kulenga. Phoqa ukuyiyeka kuzophazamisa noma yini eyifakayo.
single_instance_force_failed: Ikhophi esebenzayo ayikwazanga ukuqedwa. Ziyeke ngokwakho, bese uqala isibuyekezo futhi.
single_instance_busy_body: Ikhophi esebenzayo ifaka isofthiwe noma ukukhuluma nesidlali, ngakho ukuyiqeda manje kuzokuphazamisa lokho. Lokhu kwethulwa kuzovala; sebenzisa iwindi elikhona noma isithonjana sebha yemenyu lapho ukufaka kuqeda.
notices_summary_body: Vula Izaziso kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uzifunde.
toast_battery_charged: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lokhu kusidlali sakho, shaja ibhethri okungenani ihora
toast_battery_charged_device: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lokhu kudivayisi yakho, shaja ibhethri okungenani ihora
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Nika amandla izaziso ezingemuva ukuze uthole isibuyekezo futhi ukhiphe izexwayiso ngisho noma i-Update ivaliwe kubha yemenyu.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Nika amandla izaziso ezingemuva ukuze uthole isibuyekezo futhi ukhiphe izexwayiso ngisho noma i-Update ivaliwe kuthreyi yesistimu.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Amasevisi okuhumusha aku-inthanethi okwamanje awafinyeleleki noma apholile. Amanothi okukhishwa asekuqaleni azoboniswa esikhundleni salokho.
translate_unavailable_hint: Ukuhumusha akutholakali okwamanje. Hlola ukuxhumeka kwakho kwe-inthanethi noma uzame futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
sel_notes_hint: Khetha ukukhishwa ukuze ubuke uhlu lwayo lokushintsha
flash_wait_desc: Cisha idivayisi kuqala. Uma ixhunyiwe kodwa ingatholakali, zama ikhebula le-USB elihlukile noma imbobo.
dialog_pre_install_header: Sicela uqiniseke ukuthi i-{model} yakho ivaliwe futhi ayixhunyiwe nge-USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Cisha idivayisi yakho ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuqala.
• Uma ucingo luqandisiwe noma lungasabeli, sebenzisa iphinikhodi noma isiqeshana sephepha embobeni yokusetha kabusha ukuze ucime ukucisha kumodi yokukhipha.
• Gcina ikhebula le-USB linqanyuliwe okwamanje.
• Chofoza okuthi Qhubeka, bese uxhuma idivayisi yakho nge-USB uma utshelwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Cisha ngokuphelele idivayisi yakho ye-MediaTek.
• Gcina ikhebula le-USB linqanyuliwe okwamanje.
• Kuye ngemodeli, zama ukuxhuma ufake noma ngaphandle kwebhethri (noma ubambe Ivolumu Phansi/Phezulu ngenkathi uxhuma).
• Chofoza okuthi Qhubeka, bese uxhuma ikhebula le-USB uma utshelwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Asikwazi ukugcina idatha yakho yalokhu kufakwa ngoba i-firmware yakho yamanje ayihambisani ne-Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Nqamula ikhebula le-USB futhi usebenzise i-paperclip noma iphinikhodi ukuze ucindezele inkinobho yokusetha kabusha, bese uzama ukuxhuma futhi.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Kutuswa ukuxhuma isidlali kushaja yasodongeni imizuzu engama-30 kuya ehoreni ngaphambi kokuzama ukuxhuma.
keep_data_running_fmt: Ingabe i-{software} isivele ifakiwe ku-{model} yakho?
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Ingabe isofthiwe isivele ifakiwe ku-{model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware: Iyiphi isofthiwe esebenzayo okwamanje ku-{model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Uma ungenaso isiqiniseko, khetha 'Okunye' noma isofthiwe ocabanga ukuthi ifakiwe.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Ukuze uqhubeke nalokhu kufakwa, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi ingabe i-{model} yakho isivele isebenzisa isofthiwe eyisisekelo edingekayo ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Singagcina izilungiselelo zakho nemidiya kuphela uma isidlali sesivele sisebenzisa le softhiwe noma inguqulo ehambisanayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Singagcina izilungiselelo zakho kuphela uma isidlali sesivele sisebenzisa le softhiwe noma inguqulo ehambisanayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Singagcina izilungiselelo zakho nemidiya kuphela uma isidlali sesivele sisebenzisa le softhiwe noma inguqulo ehambisanayo.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Vumela Gcina Izilungiselelo Nemidiya kunoma yikuphi ukufakwa kwe-firmware
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Yeqa umbuzo wokuhambisana. Sebenzisa lokhu kuphela uma uqinisekile ukuthi isidlali sizoqhubeka nokusebenza ngezilungiselelo zayo zamanje kanye nemidiya.
err_keep_data_failed: Ayikwazanga ukugcina izilungiselelo zakho nemidiya: ifolda ye-firmware ayibhaleki. Akukho okufakiwe.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Igcina izilungiselelo zakho nemidiya kusidlali. Yonke enye isofthiwe ifakiwe njengokujwayelekile.
flash_keep_data_warning: Uma uqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu, izilungiselelo zakho nemidiya izosethwa kabusha kwisitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Uma uqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu, amatimu akho e-Rockbox, amafonti nezilungiselelo kuzosuswa. Umculo wakho neminye imidiya izohlala kusidlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Uma uqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu, amatimu akho e-Rockbox, amafonti nezilungiselelo zizokhishwa, futhi isitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali sizosethwa kabusha.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Uma uqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu, izilungiselelo zakho zizosethwa kabusha. Umculo wakho neminye imidiya izohlala kusidlali.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Le firmware kufanele ifomethe kabusha isitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali. Izilungiselelo ezilondoloziwe zizosuswa; umculo wakho neminye imidiya izohlala isendaweni.
format_all_data_warning_other: Le firmware kufanele ifomethe kabusha isitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali. Izilungiselelo ezilondoloziwe nemidiya egcinwe kusitoreji esakhelwe ngaphakathi izosuswa. Imidiya ku-microSD yakho ihlala isendaweni.
format_all_confirm_question: Fometha kabusha isitoreji sangaphakathi kokuthi {model} yakho?
format_all_confirm_body:
Ukuze {software} sidinga ukufometha kabusha {model} isitoreji sakho sangaphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi siqhubeke. Bese kuzanywa omunye umzamo we-SP Flash Tool, kodwa ngemodi ye-Format All + Download kusetshenziswa i-XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Nqamula i-USB, bese ufaka isiqeshana sephepha noma iphinikhodi embotsheni yokusetha kabusha ku-{model} yakho. Chofoza Okulandelayo ukuze uzame futhi kumodi yeFometha Konke + Landa.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: Ithuluzi le-SP Flash libike ukuthi ithebula lokuhlukanisa lomdlali lishintshile (8502). Le firmware kufanele ifakwe kumodi yeFometha Konke + Landa, efometha kabusha isitoreji sangaphakathi.
install_first_hint: Ngaphambi kokumisa okuthi {target} okokuqala, {model} yakho idinga ukuthi isebenze {software} — noma {target} ngokwayo, uma isivele ifakiwe futhi isebenza.
install_first_version_fmt: Ingabe i-{model} yakho isivele iyahlangabezana nemfuneko {software} ({version})?
install_first_power_on_fmt: Sicela unqamule i-USB, vula i-{model} yakho bese uchofoza Okulandelayo.
install_first_power_on_hint: Vumela isidlali siqale kanye ku-base firmware, bese uyivala ukuze ufake okulandelayo.

I-SP Flash Tool GUI manje izokwethula.

• Uma ingakavaliwe, cisha idivayisi yakho.
• Uma ixhumeke ku-USB, yinqamule kuqala.

support_story_1_lead: Ukuvikela idivayisi yakho ezingibeni ezithulile zehadiwe kanye nezibuyekezo eziphukile.
support_story_1_body: I-Innioasis ivamise ukukhipha ama-firmware amasha kubadlali abafana ne-Y1 (iqondise ukubuyekezwa kwebhodi elifihliwe njenge-6.0, 7.0, ne-8.0) ephula buthule amadivayisi amadala. Okubi nakakhulu, iwebhusayithi yabo inikeza izexwayiso ezingenalutho kanye nokufinyelela okuyiziro kuma-firmwares angaphambilini asebenzayo ukuze alulame esimweni esizitini. I-Updater CE kanye nephrojekthi ye-Firmware Yomphakathi ithatha izingcezu: sifaka kungobo yomlando yonke i-ROM yesitoko esiyigugu, siqinisekisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ukubuyekezwa kwakho kwehadiwe, futhi sigcine umdlali wakho esebenza ngokuphepha.
support_story_1_item_1: Ukuhlenga Abadlali Abaphukile: Ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kuqinisekisa ukuthi izibuyekezo azilokothi zibe izitini zehadiwe endala.
support_story_1_item_2: Ama-ROM Ayisitoko Agciniwe: Iqoqo eliphelele lama-firmware asekuqaleni asembonini i-Innioasis asusiwe.
support_story_1_item_3: I-Native Cross-Platform: Amathuluzi agcwele akhanyayo we-macOS, Linux, neWindows ngokufanayo.
support_story_1_item_4: I-Hardware Intelligence: Ukutholwa kwebhodi okuzenzakalelayo ukuze uhlale uthola iphakheji elilungile.
support_story_2_headline: Awekho ama-Google Drives aphukile. Awukho umsebenzi wokuqagela. I-firmware esebenzayo nje.
support_story_2_lead: Ingqalasizinda yomphakathi enesivinini esikhulu, eqinisekisiwe ongancika kuyo.
support_story_2_body: Ukulandelela phansi isofthiwe ye-Innioasis esemthethweni ngokuvamile kusho izinkundla zokuhlola izixhumanisi ze-Google Drayivu eziphelelwe yisikhathi, amasheya efu e-Baidu afile, namafayela e-zip ayimfihlakalo angenawo amathuluzi akhanyayo. Sakhe inethiwekhi yokulanda ethembekile, ezimele enobuqotho obuqinisekisiwe be-SHA-256, izaziso zokubuyekeza, nokufakwa okuqondiswa isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Iminikelo yakho igcina ngokuqondile okulandiwe nokubamba okwenza lokhu kwenzeke amahora angu-24 ngosuku, izinsuku ezingu-365 ngonyaka.

support_story_2_item_2: Buyekeza Izaziso: Thola ukwaziswa lapho ukukhishwa okusha komphakathi noma ukulungiswa kwehla.
support_story_2_item_3: Ukufakwa Okuqondisiwe Kwesinyathelo Nesinyathelo: Sula imiyalo ebonakalayo ikuhambisa kukho konke ukucindezela inkinobho.
support_story_2_item_4: Umphakathi Osebenzisa Izilimi Eziningi: Yenziwe yasendaweni ngokugcwele ngesiNgisi, isiShayina, isiJalimane, iSpanishi, isiFulentshi nesiJapane.
support_story_3_headline: Ukuvula amandla aphelele omdlali wakho we-Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Iletha i-Rockbox, amasistimu wokusebenza angasindi ngokwezifiso, kanye nenkululeko ye-audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Isoftware yemboni yesitoko iklwebha kuphela lokho okungenziwa izingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha ze-Y1 noma i-Y2 yakho. Umphakathi wethu ulethe i-Rockbox, amasistimu wokusebenza ngokwezifiso angasindi, ukudlalwa kwe-codec ye-audiophile, nezindikimba zangokwezifiso ekuphileni. Sithenga ukuhluka kwezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha ezingokoqobo ngaphandle kwephakethe ukuze sihlole, sihlehlise unjiniyela, futhi siqinisekise konke ukufakwa. I-Updater CE esekelayo ixhasa ngokuqondile la mayunithi wokuhlola futhi isheshisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-firmware yangokwezifiso.
support_story_3_item_1: I-One-Click Rockbox: Ukudlala kwe-Audiophile nezindikimba ngokwezifiso ezifakwe ngemizuzwana.
support_story_3_item_2: I-Firmware Yomphakathi: Izithuthukisi zebhethri, i-UI ehlanzekile, nokusekelwa kwekhodekhi yomsindo yesimanje.
support_story_3_item_3: Ilebhu Yekhompuyutha Esebenzayo: Sihlola kumadivayisi angokoqobo ngaphambi kokukhipha noma isiphi isakhiwo.
support_story_3_item_4: I-Zero Bloatware: I-100% yamahhala, isofthiwe yokuqala yobumfihlo engenazo izikhangiso noma ukulandelwa.
support_story_4_lead: Ukugcinwa kwe-firmware okuxhaswe ngumphakathi kugcina idivayisi yakho ingangeni ezindaweni zokulahla imfucuza.
support_story_4_body: Lapho inkampani yehadiwe idlulela kugajethi yayo elandelayo, amamodeli amadala ayalahlwa. I-Innioasis ayihlinzeki ngosekelo lwe-Linux, awekho amalogi okushintsha asobala, futhi ayikho indlela elula yokuphinda athole lapho ukufakwa kwehluleka. I-Updater CE ikhona ngoba abasebenzisi abanothando akufanele balahle isidlali somculo esihle kakhulu. U-100% weminikelo yomphakathi ungena ngqo ekugcineni leli thuluzi livulekele wonke umuntu.
support_story_4_item_1: I-Rescue & Unbrick: Ukuthola kabusha okuqinisekisiwe kuyageleza ngisho noma amadivayisi enqaba ukuqalisa.
support_story_4_item_2: Ukusekelwa Kwekilasi Lokuqala le-Linux: I-MediaTek ekhanyayo esekelwa ngokugcwele ku-Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: I-Transparent Changelogs: Amanothi okukhululwa anemininingwane ukuze wazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko.
support_story_4_item_4: I-100% Exhaswa Umphakathi: Ikhofi ngalinye ligcina ingobo yomlando ivulekile futhi imahhala kubo bonke.
support_methods_subtitle: Khetha indlela yakho yokunikela oyincamelayo. Wonke umnikelo ukhokhela ngokuqondile ukulanda, ukusingathwa, nezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha zokuhlola.

retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Xhuma ikhebula le-USB futhi, bese uyazama futhi.

linux_engine_staged_desc: I-MediaTek SP Flash Tool isesiteji esihambisana ne-libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Chofoza okuthi Hlola kabusha noma qala kabusha ukusetha ukuze ulande iphakheji.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Imithetho yeMediaTek iyasebenza (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Ukufinyelela kudeskithophu kunikwe amandla.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Nikeza izimvume kanye ukuze uhlelo lokusebenza luxhumane nedivayisi yakho.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Izimvume ze-USB nemithetho ye-udev ifakwe ngempumelelo. Amasevisi amisiwe.
donate_rely_on_you: Sisize ngezindleko zethu zokusebenza, sinikele namuhla.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vula i-MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: Uhlelo lokusebenza lusethwe kabusha ngokuphelele lwaba okumisiwe, inqolobane yokulanda isuliwe, futhi isikhumbuzi sebhethri sibuyiselwe.
log_app_reset_defaults: Ukulungiselelwa kohlelo lokusebenza kusethwe kabusha ngokuphelele kokumisiwe, inqolobane yokulanda isuliwe, futhi isikhumbuzi sebhethri sibuyiselwe (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ilinde umdlali wakho ukuthi aqale kabusha...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Igcine ixhunyiwe, i-Rockbox iyaqala futhi amatimu ayo azokwengezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Hlola ukuthi ixhunyiwe futhi ivuliwe. Uma kuhlala kumnyama, cindezela iphinikhodi embobeni yokusetha kabusha bese ubamba inkinobho ephakathi nendawo (Y1) noma inkinobho yamandla (abanye abadlali) ukuze uyiqale kabusha. Uma namanje ingeke iqale, i-firmware ayizange ithathe, faka enye.
action_flash_complete: I-Flash iqediwe! Nqamula i-USB bese uqalisa kabusha.
action_recover_powercycle: Umjikelezo wamandla wesidlali (bamba amandla ~10s), bese usixhuma kabusha - iyazama futhi...
action_wait_mtk: Ilinde idivayisi ye-MTK... Vala idivayisi bese uxhuma i-USB.
action_da_stall: Idivayisi iyeke ukuphendula ngenkathi ilungisa i-ejenti yokulanda. Ivale ngokuphelele, xhuma kabusha, bese uzama futhi.
action_detected_brom: Idivayisi itholiwe (imodi ye-BROM) - ilungiselela umenzeli wokulanda...
action_detected_preloader: Idivayisi itholiwe (imodi yokulayishwa kuqala) - ilungiselela umenzeli wokulanda...
action_da_wait_back: Umdlali uyeke ukuphendula ngenkathi eqala i-ejenti yokulanda. Ilinde ukuthi ibuye...
log_sparse_fmt: Kutholwe isithombe esincane se-Android {part}, siguqulelwa kunqubo...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Ukuqinisekiswa kwethebula lokuhlukanisa kuhlulekile ngemva kokubhala
err_sp_wrong_model: Uxhume imodeli engalungile yomdlali. Chofoza inkinobho ethi × ukuze ukhansele lokhu kufakwa, bese ukhetha isofthiwe yesidlali osixhume.
err_sp_timeout: Ithuluzi alikaze limbone umdlali. Yigcine ivaliwe futhi ingaxhumekile, bese uxhuma ikhebula le-USB uma ucelwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Umdlali unikwe amandla ngaphambi kwesikhathi kakhulu. Ivale ngokuphelele, bese uyixhuma futhi.
err_sp_download_fail: Ukubhala kuphazanyiswe. Hlola ikhebula le-USB nembobo kanye nokushajwa kwebhethri, bese uyazama futhi.
err_sp_da_init_sync: I-ejenti yokulanda ayikwazanga ukuqala. Zama enye indlela ye-flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: I-ejenti yokulanda ayithunyelwanga kumdlali. Yivale bese uxhuma kabusha.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Umdlali unqabe i-ejenti yokulanda (iphutha 6104). Sebenzisa i-ejenti yokulanda ehlanganiswe ne-SP Flash Tool, bese uhlola ukuthi i-firmware iyafana nalesi sidlali.
err_sp_com_port: Ithuluzi alikwazanga ukuvula imbobo yalo ye-serial. Vala amanye amathuluzi akhanyayo bese uxhuma kabusha.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Imbobo ye-USB COM ayikwazanga ukuvulwa (iphutha 1013). Ukuqalisa kabusha ikhompuyutha yakho kuzokhulula imbobo ekhiyiwe. Sicela uqale kabusha ikhompuyutha yakho bese uzama futhi.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ithuluzi alikwazanga ukuqalisa inkumbulo yomdlali. Sebenzisa iphakheji eyakhelwe le modeli ncamashi.
err_sp_storage_read: Ithuluzi alikwazanga ukufunda isitoreji somdlali. Hlola uxhumano; idivayisi ingase ibe nephutha lehadiwe.
err_attempt_timeout: Ithuluzi elikhanyayo alizange libonise ukuqhubeka phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-{seconds}, ngakho-ke lo mzamo uye wamiswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Ayikwazanga ukusungula ukuxhumana okuzinzile nomdlali. Qinisekisa ukuthi idivayisi ivaliwe (sebenzisa iphinikhodi ukuze ucindezele inkinobho yokusetha kabusha uma kudingeka), khipha i-USB, bese uxhuma kabusha lapho uyalwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ukukhanyisa kuphazanyisiwe noma umsebenzi wokubhala wehlulekile. Hlola ukuthi ikhebula le-USB lixhunywe ngokuqinile yini futhi nebhethri lineshaji elanele, bese uyazama futhi.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ithuluzi elikhanyayo libonise umugqa ofanayo kumasekhondi wokugcina {seconds} futhi alibonakali liqhubeka nokubhala i-firmware. I-flash kungenzeka yehlulekile. Uma lokhu bekuwumzamo wokugcina kwemibili ngendlela ngayinye kusistimu ekwazi ukubuyela emuva phakathi kwayo, noma uma kuphela i-MTKClient itholakala kulo mshini, qalisa kabusha ikhompuyutha bese uzama futhi.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: I-MTKClient kuphela etholakalayo kulokhu kufakwa. I-flash kungenzeka yehlulekile. Sicela uqale kabusha ikhompuyutha bese uzama futhi.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Le khompyutha ingaphinda ifake isebenzisa i-SP Flash Tool. Uma ukwazi, shintshela ku-SP Flash Tool bese uzama futhi.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: I-flash kungenzeka yehlulekile. Sicela ufunde umlayezo ongenhla bese uqala kabusha ikhompuyutha ngaphambi kokuzama futhi. Uma uchofoza okuthi KULUNGILE, uhlelo lokusebenza luzoyeka ukuze uqale kabusha.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iphakheji ye-firmware ayinalo ifayela le-scatter noma amafayela esithombe adingekayo. Sicela ulande kabusha iphakheji noma ukhethe ifayela eliphelele le-firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Ifayela lokufakazela ubuqiniso olikhethile alikho, alinalutho noma alikwazanga ukubhalwa. Khetha ifayela elivumelekile, noma lisule kokuthi Izilungiselelo, bese ukhanyisa futhi.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ithuluzi elikhanyayo noma izishayeli zesistimu ezidingekayo azikwazanga ukuqaliswa. Sicela uhlole izimvume zesistimu, ukusethwa komshayeli, noma ufake kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza.
err_driver_missing_desc: Leli phutha lingenzeka uma isishayeli se-USB seMediaTek singafakiwe. Chofoza okuthi Landa Abashayeli ukuze ufake isishayeli se-MediaTek USB, qala kabusha ikhompuyutha yakho, bese uzama futhi.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Ifayela le-firmware elifakwe kunqolobane alikho. Khetha Khetha Isofthiwe ukuze wakhe kabusha amafayela akhishiwe noma ulande ingobo yomlando ye-firmware futhi. Lena inkinga yefayela lendawo, hhayi inkinga yokuxhuma nge-USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Buyela kokuthi Khetha Isofthiwe ukuze wakhe kabusha noma ulande iphakheji ye-firmware.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kwenzeke iphutha elingalindelekile phakathi nokufakwa ({detail}). Cisha isidlali ngokuphelele, xhuma kabusha lapho utshelwa, bese uzama futhi.
flash_method_confirm: Indlela yokufaka ishintshile ukuze ithi {method}. Qinisekisa ukuthi isidlali asixhunyiwe futhi sivaliwe, bese uchofoza Okulandelayo.
flash_failover_note: {method} ayizange iqalise ukufakwa. Ngemuva kokuthi isidlali sicishiwe futhi sinqanyuliwe, {other} izosetshenziswa esikhundleni salokho.
themepack_card_desc: Kufaka amatimu amahle omphakathi, okwasemuva kokucaca okuphezulu, namafonti enzelwe ngokukhethekile izibonisi ezingu-360p.
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Vula isidlali sakho ngokubamba inkinobho yamandla.
2. Uma i-Rockbox iqala, xhuma ikhebula le-USB kukhompyutha yakho.
3. Uma utshelwa esikrinini sesidlali, qinisekisa imodi Yesitoreji Se-USB ukuze idivayisi ivele njengedrayivu.
themepack_step2_title: Isinyathelo sesi-2: Khetha Noma iyiphi Ifolda Kusidlali
themepack_step2_desc: Ngenxa yokuthi amasistimu wokusebenza (njenge-macOS) afihla amachashazi (njenge-.rockbox) ngokuzenzakalelayo, ungakhetha YIYIPHI ifolda noma impande yokushayela kusidlali sakho. Sizokuthola ngokuzenzakalelayo noma sikudalele uhla lwemibhalo lwe-.rockbox.
themepack_complete: Iphekhi yetimu ifakwe ngempumelelo! Manje usunganqamula ngokuphephile isidlali sakho bese ukhetha itimu ku-Rockbox (Izilungiselelo > Izilungiselelo Zetimu).
themepack_err_not_found: Ayikwazanga ukuthola noma ukuqalisa inkomba ye-.rockbox kudrayivu ekhethiwe. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi ukhethe ifolda kusidlali sakho.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Isinyathelo 1: Qala kabusha isidlali bese uxhuma kabusha
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Nqamula ikhebula le-USB.
2. Vuselela isidlali futhi usivumele siqale ku-Rockbox.
3. Uma i-Rockbox isebenza, xhuma kabusha ikhebula le-USB, bese ucindezela Qhubeka.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Uhlelo lokusebenza lubheke uxhumano lwe-ADB (kufika kumasekhondi angu-30). Uma idivayisi itholwa, izingqikithi ziyadluliswa futhi isidlali siqaliswe kabusha ngokuzenzakalela. Uma kungenjalo, yeqela uye kuModi Yesitoreji Se-USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Ayikho idivayisi ye-ADB etholwe phakathi nemizuzwana engama-30; iqhubeka ne-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Ayikho kanambambili ye-ADB etholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza; iqhubeka ne-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Ukudluliswa kwe-ADB kwehlulekile; ibuyela kumodi yesitoreji se-USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Nika amandla Imodi Yesitoreji Se-USB esidlalini ukuze sibonakale njengedrayivu.
2. Khetha YILUPHI ifolda kusidlali esingezansi (.rockbox, Umculo, Izindikimba, noma impande yokushayela, ifolda ye-.rockbox efihliwe itholakala ngokuzenzakalelayo).
3. Uhlelo lokusebenza luhlanganisa izingqikithi namafonti angu-360p, lubhale ngaphezulu amafayela egama elifanayo.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Manje unganqamula ngokuphephile isidlali bese ukhetha itimu ku-Rockbox (Izilungiselelo > Izilungiselelo Zetimu).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Isofthiwe yakho entsha ifakiwe, kodwa ifolda endala ye-.rockbox ayikwazanga ukususwa. Susa ifolda ye-.rockbox kumdlali ngesandla uma ufuna isiqalo esihlanzekile.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Kuxhunywe abadlali abangaphezu koyedwa. Nqamula ezinye futhi ushiye eyodwa kuphela efakiwe.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Umdlali utholiwe. Ibeka amatimu namafonti omphakathi...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Bamba inkinobho ephakathi ukuze uvule i-Y1 yakho, xhuma kabusha i-USB, bese ukhetha Imodi Yesitoreji Se-USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Bamba inkinobho yamandla ukuze uvule isidlali sakho, xhuma kabusha i-USB, bese ukhetha Imodi Yesitoreji Se-USB.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Sicela unqamule bese uvula i-{model} yakho, bese ucindezela okuthi Okulandelayo
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Nqamula i-USB, ubambe okuthi {button} ukuze uvule {model} yakho, bese ucindezela okuthi Okulandelayo.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Sicela uvule imodi yesitoreji se-USB kudivayisi yakho bese uchofoza Okulandelayo
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Sicela uvule imodi yesitoreji se-USB kokuthi {model} yakho, bese ukhetha idrayivu evelayo
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Sicela ukhethe isidlali ngokwaso noma ifolda eyodwa ekuso
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Nqamula i-USB bese uvula i-Y1 yakho, bese ucindezela Okulandelayo.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Nqamula i-USB bese uvula i-{model} yakho, bese ucindezela okuthi Okulandelayo.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Khetha 'Imodi Yesitoreji Se-USB' kusidlali sakho.
2. Chofoza 'Phequlula Ifolda...' ukuze ukhethe isidlali sakho bese usifaka izingqikithi.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Lesi sakhiwo se-Rockbox sisebenzisa izingqikithi ezingama-240×320, ezingahlanganisiwe. Thola izingqikithi zamahhala zomdlali wakho kusayithi letimu ye-Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Uma i-{model} yakho ingaqalisi, nqamula i-USB, ubambe inkinobho yamandla ukuze u-10s ukusetha kabusha, futhi uvule. Noma buyisela isofthiwe yoqobo.
err_storage_full_desc: Ikhompyutha yakho isiphelelwe yindawo yokugcina. Sicela ukhulule isikhala sediski kudrayivu yakho bese uzama futhi.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Inguqulo endala ye-Update isakule khompuyutha futhi ithatha isikhala sediski. Ukuyikhipha kukhulula leso sikhala.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Susa uhlelo lokusebenza oludala lwe-Innioasis Updater namafolda okusekela
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Gcina amathuluzi e-Android Platform (ADB / Fastboot) efakiwe
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Uma ungayisebenzisi i-ADB noma i-Fastboot ngaphandle kwe-Updater CE, yekisa ukuthikha ukuze ukhiphe futhi ufune kabusha isitoreji esengeziwe.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Ihlanze ngempumelelo ukufakwa kwefa kanye nesikhala sediski kabusha.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Inguqulo endala ye-Update isakule khompuyutha. Ukuyikhipha kukhulula isikhala sediski.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Lokhu kususa ngokuphelele uhlelo lokusebenza oludala, i-firmware elandiwe, namafayela asele.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Susa namathuluzi e-Android Platform (ADB / Fastboot)? Khetha Gcina uma usebenzisa i-ADB.
settings_arm64_driver_note: Ukusekelwa kweWindows kwe-ARM64 akuhloliwe. Kumakhompuyutha aphathekayo e-Snapdragon kanye ne-RTX Spark, i-Zadig ingasetshenziswa ne-Driver Signature Enforcement ikhutshaziwe ukufaka i-WinUSB noma i-libusb yedivayisi Yokulayisha kuqala ye-MT6227 Kumphathi Wedivayisi. Bheka umhlahlandlela womshayeli we-ARM64 ukuze uthole izinyathelo.
